'''Christoph Birghan''' (born 23 June 1970 in [[Berlin]]) is a German politician from the [[Alternative for Germany]] (AfD). He has been a [[member of the German Bundestag]] since the [[2025 German federal election]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Deutscher Bundestag - Dr. Christoph Birghan |url=https://www.bundestag.de/abgeordnete/biografien/B/birghan_christoph-1043712 |access-date=2025-03-13 |website=Deutscher Bundestag |language=de}}</ref>

Birghan was AfD district chairman in [[Steinhöring]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-02-20 |title=AfD-Mann marschbereit Richtung Bundestag: Kreis Ebersberg wohl mit zweitem Abgeordneten in Berlin |url=https://www.merkur.de/lokales/ebersberg/steinhoering-ort29489/afd-mann-marschbereit-richtung-bundestag-kreis-ebersberg-wohl-bald-mit-zweitem-abgeordneten-in-berlin-93581284.html |access-date=2025-03-13 |website=www.merkur.de |language=de}}</ref> In the 2025 federal election he was the [[direct candidate]] in [[Traunstein (electoral district)|Traunstein]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr. Christoph Birghan ist AfD-Direktkandidat |url=https://www.traunsteiner-tagblatt.de/startseite_artikel,-dr-christoph-birghan-ist-afddirektkandidat-_arid,909688.html |access-date=2025-03-13 |website=www.traunsteiner-tagblatt.de |language=de}}</ref> He was elected to the Bundestag on the [[State list (Germany)|state list]].
